description: Historique - Station de en libre service "Velibleu" (Période 2019-2022) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Commune d'Anglet. Data OBSOLETES – Historical – Location, before service stop at the beginning of 2022, fixed and virtual stations of self-service electric bikes “Vélibleu” in Anglet. Coverage: Commune d'Anglet. The portal shows the English title as "History – Self-service electric bike station “Velibleu” (period 2019-2022)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Commune d'Anglet. Its keywords include velibleu, velo, mobilite-espace-public, 2019, libre-service, assistance-electrique. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, ZIP, JSON. The listing shows 2023-07-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
